title: Replicating and Extending Weight-Space Programming: Frontier LLMs Compile Programs into Weights and Read Input Layers
abstract: arXiv:2611.21449v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Researchers at MIT recently reported that GPT-6 Astra, a frontier large language model (LLM), can write the weights of small neural networks directly in a single reply, and can read the raw weights of small networks to say what they were trained to do. In a three-day sprint, we replicated and extended these results. Our four findings: (1) Writing weights reproduces. Astra's networks for the game Breakout scored 514, 550 and 307 (versus MIT's 517), and scored just as well on two modified versions of Breakout. Claude Opus 5.5 can also write working networks, but often runs out of output tokens. (2) What is new is translating programs into weights. Earlier models could write a good policy as code a generation before they could write network weights, and the networks the models write behave like compiled programs: two models independently decompiled Astra's Breakout network into Python matching its actions in all tested states. translated_title: 复现与扩展权重空间编程：前沿大语言模型将程序编译为权重并读取输入层
translated_abstract: MIT的研究人员最近报告称，前沿大语言模型（LLM）GPT-6 Astra能够在单次回复中直接写出小型神经网络的权重，并能读取小型网络的原始权重来说出它们被训练来做什么。我们在为期三天的冲刺中复现并扩展了这些结果。我们的四项发现：(1) 写权重这一结果可以复现。Astra为游戏Breakout（打砖块）生成的网络得分分别为514、550和307（MIT的结果为517），并且在两个修改版Breakout上同样表现良好。Claude Opus 5.5也能写出可正常工作的网络，但常常会耗尽输出token。(2) 真正新颖之处在于将程序翻译为权重。更早一代的模型在能够写出网络权重之前，就已能以代码形式写出良好的策略，而且模型写出的网络表现得如同编译后的程序：两个模型独立地将Astra的Breakout网络反编译为Python代码，在所有测试状态下都与其实际行为相符。在分类（任务上）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究复现并扩展了MIT的发现——前沿大语言模型能够直接写出小型神经网络的权重、读取权重以理解网络的功能，且模型写出的网络表现得如同被“编译”成权重的程序。
en_tdlr: This study replicates and extends MIT's findings that frontier LLMs can directly write neural network weights and read raw weights to understand what networks do, showing that the written networks behave like compiled programs.
